title: Chapter 86
text:
Pan Kuang was a Level 38 Pugilist with high attack and agility. His Intelligence could not be higher than 50 points. If he was really lucky, Han Xiao would choose to hit him on the spot.

The illusion made Pan Kuang defenseless. All of his attacks were close to real damage. However, his level was high, so he would not be affected for long.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao punched Pan Kuang's lower body with his left mechanical arm, aiming for Pan Kuang's vitals!

"Overload!"

The power output of the mechanical arm increased by 30%, and the punch hit the bullseye.

Violent Chicken! (Yes, that's right.)

This move was a divine skill that he had comprehended after observing countless images and data. Once he used it, even the heavens and earth would tremble.

There was no time to look at the information. While Pan Kuang was still under control, Han Xiao immediately activated the air pressure oscillator in the palm of his mechanical arm. He shook his palm, and the shock wave penetrated his body. Blood seeped through his skin and dyed his lower body red. His right hand was not idle either. He stabbed Pan Kuang's chest without hesitation. Pan Kuang was affected by the illusion, so he did not use his energy to protect himself. The attack went straight through. Han Xiao immediately pulled out the Berserk Eagle and pressed it against Pan Kuang's chest. He slid forward and pushed Pan Kuang back. He activated the magazine and fired all the bullets into Pan Kuang's body.

Blood splattered everywhere, mixing with the flames. The sound of flesh being penetrated could be heard.

The magazine was empty. Pan Kuang finally regained consciousness. The pain made his face contort in anger. He stabbed Han Xiao's lower abdomen. He was giving Pan Kuang a taste of his own medicine. He was going to attack little Han Xiao. Han Xiao used his energy to control the magnetically-controlled metal to protect his vitals. He blocked the attack, but the impact made his face pale. He felt a chill run down his spine. He endured the pain and extended his mechanical arm. He grabbed Pan Kuang's head and threw him to the ground.

The back of Pan Kuang's head came in contact with the ground many times, and a pool of blood gradually formed. He roared in pain and counterattacked. His long sword left afterimages in its wake, and Han Xiao's health dropped rapidly.

"Hundred Wind Rend!"

Pan Kuang roared in agony. His long saber suddenly emitted a dazzling saber light.

Han Xiaoxin was alerted. He hurriedly stood up and retreated. At that moment, the Windcutter Blade released multiple rays of light that surrounded Pan Kuang like a tornado. Countless deep marks were left on the ground around Pan Kuang. Han Xiao was hit head-on, and the durability of his Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor plummeted. Because the attack range of this skill was too large, the areas that were not protected by the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor became a bloody mess. A series of 40 damage values popped up.

The flash of the blade lasted for three seconds before it stopped. Han Xiao retreated ten meters away, gasping for air. Blood mixed with sweat dripped down his face as he stared at Pan Kuang. Pan Kuang would not be able to use the same attack consecutively, and the cooldown period would not be short.

Pan Kuang stood up with the help of his saber. He looked miserable. His lower body was badly mangled, and his chest was filled with bullet holes. The flames were still burning, and the smell of burnt flesh was coming out. The burning and bleeding had caused him to suffer double damage. His body was in a terrible condition. The Retractable Knife was still in his chest. His face was even worse. His nose was broken, and his bones were visible at the back of his head. He looked like a ghost!

And this ghost was staring at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao was on high alert. He was ready to add all his AP to END. This was his other trump card.

A gust of wind blew up the dust, but it also took away a trace of the murderous aura.

Pan Kuang slowly lowered his head and stopped breathing.

The last trace of life was burned away by the continuous damage. It was like the last straw that broke the camel's back.

You have killed Pan Kuang (LV38). You have received 21000 EXP.

You have killed a target 10 levels above you. You have received 280% EXP bonus. Total EXP: 58800. Your damage output is 99%.

You have received 58212 (99%) EXP.

[Beheading III] completed. Damage output is 99%. You have received 79200 EXP.

158,500 EXP!

That was all that Han Xiao had received from killing Pan Kuang!

Killing someone above one's level would result in additional rewards. The minimum requirement for triggering the reward was to be five levels above one's level. The additional EXP would be distributed according to the damage output. This was because most of the time, players would form a team to complete the mission. If there was a player in the team who did not meet the requirements, the entire team would not be able to receive the reward. Therefore, the team valued the cooperation of the players' battle tactics and skill.

Of course, there were also experts who could solo players above their level.

Han Xiao's expression relaxed. He sat down on the ground and let the sun shine on his face. He closed his eyes comfortably and enjoyed the peace after the battle. The smoke, flames, and blood around him did not exist.

He suddenly thought of something. He quickly jumped up and pulled down his pants to check on little Han Xiao. He heaved a sigh of relief.

Good, good, good. He was not damaged. He was still a sleeping dragon.

After resting for a while, he began to check on the damage. The durability of his equipment had dropped quite a bit, and the delay explosion had been used up. His own health was slowly recovering, and the damage was still within an acceptable range.

Han Xiao walked over to Pan Kuang's corpse, pried open his fingers, and pulled out the Wind-Cutter Blade. He flicked the blade with his finger, and it made a crisp sound.

The additional effect of this green cold weapon is quite ordinary. However, its attack is twice as strong as the Retractable Knife.

He put away the Wind-Cutter Blade and walked over to Ji Jie's corpse to search for loot. Suddenly, he found a hard object in the corpse's pocket. He took it out and saw that it was a communication terminal of the Germinal Organization.

Han Xiao turned his eyes and activated the communication terminal. Ten seconds later, the holographic image of the leader appeared.

"Ji Jie, have you retreated …" The leader was halfway through his sentence when he realized that the communication terminal had changed. It was Han Xiao with a faint smile on his face. The leader's expression changed as he stared at Han Xiao.

"Why are you here?"

Zero had used Ji Jie's communication terminal. The situation was clear. The Dark Crow Valley base had been destroyed, and Pan Kuang was most likely dead.

The leader was enraged. "You dare to contact me on your own accord?"

Han Xiao smiled and said, "Yo, long time no see."

What's with the tone of an old friend reuniting? Give me some awareness as an enemy! The leader couldn't catch his breath. After half a second, he asked, "Where did you get this confidential information?"

This was what he had been wondering all along.

Han Xiao looked at her as if she was looking at a melon. "Why do you think I'll answer you?"

The leader said angrily, "Do you think you can damage the organization's power with this kind of method? How naive! "

"I destroyed four of your bases."

"An ant trying to shake a tree, I can easily crush you to death!"

"I destroyed four of your bases."

"There are countless executives in the organization. You won't be free for long!"

"I destroyed four of your bases."

AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

The leader sounded like he was chewing on steel. Every word was filled with murderous intent. "Don't think that you can survive just because you joined Stardragon. When my people find you, I'll pull out every single one of your tendons and bones!"

Han Xiao chuckled. He pressed his finger on his lips and threw a flirtatious kiss.

"Then come and find me. If you find me, I'll let you have some fun."

The leader flew into a rage and was about to explode from Han Xiao's mocking tone. Just as he was about to say something, Han Xiao suddenly smashed the communication terminal, and the communication screen went black.

The leader's words were stuck in his throat. He was so angry that his whole body trembled.

"Pass down my order! Zero's global bounty is increased to five million! "

It was increased by five times!

…

Han Xiao stopped smiling. Teasing the leader of the Germinal Organization was not something he did on a whim.

The Germinal Organization would definitely send people to the West Capital to find his location. They would not give up until he was dead.

It seemed to be disadvantageous to him, but it had no effect on him at all.

Because … Han Xiao had no intention of going back!
